text:
Tess (CSM): Quick thread for Citronix QBR prep — meeting Fri 11am PT. Need: short health pulse, onboarding blockers summary, token-econ (30/90d), and a one-slide cost-stabilization plan with concrete asks (cap/credits/reserve). Who takes cost?

Diego (FinOps): I can do the cost analysis. I'll pull 90d trend + 30d spike table and a 10-week forecast with three scenarios. Note: they run a daily bulk enrichment that looks like a burst window.

Rina (Solutions): I pulled their onboarding tickets. Top issues: "no starter configs", "surprising daily spikes", and "quota confusion for sandbox vs prod keys." I can prepare a starter-kit (batching defaults, cache snippet, quota guidance).

Mark (AE): Renewal discussion is in 2 weeks. CFO wants a clear near-term mitigation plan and a sample reserved-capacity quote. Also asked if we can show per-key historical spend.

ops-bot: export: citronix_tokens_4076543210.csv uploaded to s3://exports/citronix/4076543210.csv

Diego (FinOps): Uploaded initial charts and a short CSV (link in the deck). Early flag: their enrichment job creates a 3-hour burst that accounts for ~50% of daily tokens on peak days. Proposed mitigations: 1) embed cache TTL=10d for stable docs 2) stagger enrichment shards 3) quantize batch model to int8 for nightly jobs 4) temporary spend cushion (credit) while we optimize.

Rina (Solutions): Demo plan: reproduce the burst in staging and show before/after with caching + shard staggering. Example curl to reproduce a bulk batch (will show in the deck):

```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-embed-3b","inputs": ["doc1","doc2",...], "batch_size":256}'
```

I'll include tokens/sec and cost/time numbers.

Mark (AE): I'll draft the ask slide: 1) short-term credit bridge 2) 3-tier reserved quote 3) daily cap + 80% alerting + auto-throttle for pipelines. CFO also wants p99 latency comparison hosted vs dedicated.

Tess (CSM): Owners and deadlines: Diego = cost charts + forecast by Tue 1pm; Rina = demo + perf numbers by Wed 10am; Mark = ask bullets + reserved quote draft by Tue EOD. I'll compile onboarding feedback and a starter-kit by Wed noon. Dry run Fri 10:15.

Diego (FinOps): Quick note: include a table that excludes one-off onboarding migrations so the baseline reflects steady-state. I'll add hosted vs dedicated delta and estimated unit-cost at each commit level. Also will add JSON example for the alert rule and suggested thresholds.

Rina (Solutions): Starter-kit cache snippet (node) for the deck: 
```
// simple cache example
const key = hash(JSON.stringify(payload))
const cached = await cache.get(key)
if (cached) return cached
const out = await callEmbed(payload)
await cache.set(key, out, { ttl: 10 * 24 * 3600 })
return out
```

Tess (CSM): One product ask for the deck: can the Console show sandbox vs prod key spend separated by date range? We want a screenshot.

Rina (Solutions): Yes, Console supports key-level filters and date-range comparison. I'll capture a blurred screenshot and annotate differences.

Mark (AE): CFO also requested an ops-runbook for quick wins we can execute before renewal (2-week timeline). Can we list action steps and rough ETA for each?

Diego (FinOps): I'll include a runbook with estimated savings and ETA: cache + stagger (1-3 days, ~30-45% peak reduction in sim), quantize batch model (3-7 days, ~10-20% savings), set alerts + cap (same day, prevents runaway).

ops-bot: ticket CT-1102 updated: starter-kit + runbook checklist added

Tess (CSM): Great. Any blockers? If not, I'll check in Tue morning with a short status update. :sparkles:
